facts.fact: WHO reports that in the 2022-2023 biennium it supported the Department of Health Information Systems in drawing up strategies and micro-plans, strengthening use of the DHIS2 tool for data quality with a data validation component, and addressing shortcomings in the daily recording of health data in district health units and in central, district and regional services; the passage places the system with that department and gives no month.

systems.tiers: district health units and central, district and regional services, as places where health data is recorded daily

note: Passages only; the one paragraph on DHIS2 sits in the immunisation section and does not say at which level data is keyed into the system.
